    except SyntaxError:

        ast.Expression,

        ast.BinOp,
        ast.UnaryOp,
        ast.Compare,
        ast.Constant,
        ast.Name,
        ast.And,
        ast.Or,
        ast.Not,
        ast.Eq,
        ast.NotEq,
        ast.Lt,
        ast.LtE,
        ast.Gt,
        ast.GtE,
        ast.Add,
        ast.Sub,
        ast.Mult,
        ast.Div,
        ast.USub,
        ast.UAdd
    )

    def check_node(node):
        if not isinstance(node, allowed_nodes):
            return False
        for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(node):
            if not check_node(child):
                return False
        return True

    if not check_node(tree.body):
        return None

    return True
